outcome: A card with bestow may be cast for its bestow cost instead of its mana cost.
A spell cast bestowed becomes an Aura enchantment with enchant creature on the stack, requires a legal creature target, and resolves attached to it as a bestowed Aura.
A copy of a bestowed Aura spell is also a bestowed Aura spell.
Whether a spell can be cast bestowed is judged only by its bestowed characteristics, so effects stopping creature spells do not stop it while effects stopping Auras or enchantments do.
If the target of a bestowed Aura spell is illegal as it begins resolving, the spell does not fizzle but resolves as a creature spell and enters the battlefield as a creature.
A bestowed Aura that becomes unattached or attached illegally ceases to be bestowed, becomes a creature, and stays on the battlefield instead of going to the graveyard.
A bestowed Aura that phases in unattached ceases to be bestowed and is a creature.
